clauses.reason: The order exempts Walter C. Mendenhall, Director, Geological Survey, Department of the Interior, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, and fixes the period in its own words: "for a period of one year ending February 28, 1942". The end is recorded as February 28, 1942 (1942-02-28), inclusive: the exemption runs through that day. The exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is the alternative. EO 9030, signed January 20, 1942, cites this order by number ("Executive Order No. 8628 of ") and exempts the same employee again: "I hereby further exempt" ... "for a period of one year ending February 28, 1943". It states no separate effective date, so its signature date is recorded as the event date. It is a later event, not an end: it is a new exemption for a later period and does not revoke, shorten or supersede the exemption in EO 8628.
